parameters.help_en:
The container firewall status of the cluster. Valid values:
-1: unknown
0: abnormal
1: normal
2: normal pending confirmation
parameters.help_zh:
集群容器防火墙状态。
-1：未知
0：异常
1：正常
2：正常待确认
parameters.name: cluster_cnnf_status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster.
You can call the [DescribeContainerInstances](~~DescribeContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
容器集群的ID。
调用[DescribeContainerInstances](~~DescribeContainerInstances~~)接口可以获取该参数
